name: Dry Dates Mouth Freshener – 180gm
original_description:
Presenting Dry Dates Mouth Freshener Manufactured by Falcon Systems of Ayurveda , an exquisite Indian oral refreshment crafted from the essence of dry dates, a fruit native to the bountiful regions of the Middle East and North Africa. This delectable fusion is artfully composed by infusing an assortment of seeds, nuts, and a medley of ingredients with the luscious flavors and fragrances drawn from dry dates, accentuated by complementary elements that elevate its taste and aroma.

Mast Dry Dates Mouth Freshener By Zaarah Herbals stands as a highly regarded choice for post-meal indulgence, serving the dual purpose of aiding digestion and rejuvenating your breath. It distinguishes itself with its sweet, subtly fruity profile and gratifyingly crisp texture. This delightful blend comes in a dry, crunchy form, making it perfect for savoring as a snack or for maintaining optimal oral hygiene.

Benefits of Dry Dates Mouth Freshener:

  • An ideal companion for promoting digestion and revitalizing your breath after a meal.
  • Artfully crafted with dry dates, a fruit rooted in the heartlands of the Middle East and North Africa.
  • Skillfully prepared through an infusion of seeds, nuts, and a symphony of flavors and essences derived from dry dates, enhanced by harmonizing ingredients.
  • Noteworthy for its sweet, delicately fruity flavor and immensely satisfying crunch.
Ingredients:
  1. Sugar
  2. Dry dates
  3. Menthol
